(b) Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.

(c) A is true and R is false.

(d) A is false and R is true.

(c) A is true and R is false.

(d) A is false and R is true.

*The image displays a flowchart diagram illustrating the chemical processing pathways of Coal. The process begins with a single input node labeled "Coal". From this node, two primary branches diverge: one labeled "Destructive" and the other labeled "Distillation".

The "Destructive" pathway leads to a node labeled "Coal gas". From "Coal gas", a branch leads to the output node "CO" (Carbon Monoxide). Another branch from "Coal gas" leads to the output node "X". A third branch from "Coal gas" leads to the output node "H2" (Hydrogen).

The "Distillation" pathway leads to a node labeled "Coal tar". From "Coal tar", a branch leads to the output node "Y". A second branch from "Coal tar" is labeled "Fractional Distillation" and leads to the output node "Y".

The diagram visually represents the decomposition of coal into different gaseous and liquid products based on the method of processing.*
